back: Mashona, Nkone, Tuli: hardy, fertile, tolerant of heat, ticks and poor veld.
Brahman (zebu, hump, heat and tick tolerant), Hereford (red, white face, early maturing), Simmental (large, fast growth).
Deep, wide, blocky body; well-muscled hindquarters and loin; short thick neck; short legs.
About one mature bull to 25-30 cows during a breeding season of about three months.
Uniform calves managed in groups, supervised calving, feed matched to grazing, easy culling of open cows.
Protein or urea licks for low-protein grass; phosphate lick (with salt) against bone chewing and botulism.
Feeding cattle in pens for a few months on a high-energy ration to finish them quickly to a high grade.
